title: Explore more ad references with reusable research reports.
summary: Research related advertisers from a product or topic, collect broader evidence, and browse saved results in a consistent HTML report.
highlights: Research guidance targets 150 relevant video references when sufficient evidence is available, with explicit coverage gaps when sources are exhausted.
Generate a searchable HTML report with advertiser filters, original ad copy, media, and observed delivery details.
Reuse published library references before collecting fresh ads, and distinguish failed searches from verified empty results.
